description: Create a preliminary project plan, price range and development effort estimate. Use this tool to understand the main functional modules and important unresolved requirements. Provide an existing project_context_id or a project_description for a new project. Module status describes The2410's proposed solution; confirmed does not mean customer approval. Prices and working days are shares of the existing project estimate. This is a preliminary estimate, not a final specification or contractual offer.The customer's name and email are required; phone and company name are optional.

additional_requirements.description: Updated requirements or answers to planning questions. Replaces the saved additional requirements. Omit to keep them; null clears them.

company_name.description: Optional company name. Omit to keep the saved value; null clears it.

phone.description: Optional phone number. Omit to keep the saved value; null clears it.

project_context_id.description: Existing project UUID. Required when project_description is omitted.

project_description.description: Required for a new project. Omit or send null to reuse the saved description.

name: plan-project-tool
title: Plan project
